environment_requirements.notes: Upstream documents Ubuntu 18.04/20.04 with ROS Melodic/Noetic. The primary Humble machine is intentionally blocked rather than treated as a supported port.

input_requirements.notes: The official implementation consumes ROS1 messages/bags. ROS2 datasets require an explicit conversion artifact; the benchmark adapter never converts silently.

benchmark_notes: Research-tier efficiency/map-structure baseline. Upstream names its mapping extrinsic Lidar_T/R_wrt_IMU and stores it as offset_T/R_L_I, matching the benchmark LIDAR_TO_IMU convention. Absence or environment blocking does not invalidate a Core baseline run.
